in_marathi.name: Shanmuga
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of War with Six Faces
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shanmuga हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shanmuga is a name of Lord Murugan, also known as Kartikeya or Subramaniam. He is the god of war, wisdom, and knowledge. He is depicted with six heads, representing the six aspects of consciousness. Each head represents an aspect: peace, war, creation, preservation, destruction, and wisdom.
